attempted_claim: Let M=E x_S E be the relative square of the Legendre elliptic family over S=Y(2) (Kuga-type mixed Shimura variety). There exist explicit effectively computable constants C0, kappa>0 and eps0=1/12 such that for every irreducible curve C in M defined over Qbar, dominating S, of degree <=4 and not contained in any proper special subvariety, with Gao mixed Ax-Schanuel as transcendence input: (i) the R_an,exp preimage block satisfies N(Z_C^{trans}(T)) <= C0 T^{eps0}, (ii) every maximal atypical point of complexity >=T carries Galois orbit >= c1 T^kappa with kappa>eps0, hence (iii) C contains only finitely many maximal atypical special points of complexity > T0(deg(C),h(C)) with total bound B(deg,h) stated explicitly; the exponent comparison is the checkable witness.
